prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: industrial design concept sketch comparison for a Russian university diploma, to be placed as an image on an A3 landscape analytical board.
Primary request: show THREE DISTINCT preliminary home exercise equipment storage furniture concepts, organized in three equal columns and two equal rows. Plain white background, no text, no lettering, no logos, no dimensions. Each column has exactly the same concept in stored mode in the upper row and deployed mode in the lower row, with consistent scale and design. Hand drawn industrial designer pencil and fine marker sketches, clear perspective, warm light grey volumes, dark grey structure, restrained muted teal soft pads and mat, faint construction lines. Materials unresolved, no wood grain, no polished product advertising.
LEFT COLUMN: a long low fixed-top bench with a rounded rectangular cushioned top, box carcass and broad load bearing side panels. A single shallow front storage drawer, no hinged lid. Upper row drawer shut. Lower row drawer pulled partly open to reveal two small dumbbells low inside and a resistance loop; a rolled ordinary exercise mat now unrolled on the floor in FRONT of the bench. Bench remains fixed, no extending legs, no cable anchors.
MIDDLE COLUMN: two equal height independent chunky square padded stools with full width plinth bases and recessed side carry handles, each with a small side storage niche. Upper row two stools positioned next to each other like a two seat bench, visible seam between them. Lower row SAME TWO stools spaced apart on floor, ordinary unrolled exercise mat in front, light ball beside one stool, no bridging seat, no person, no join used to carry body load, no telescopic legs.
RIGHT COLUMN: a compact freestanding upright storage cabinet, rounded rectangular silhouette, taller than the bench, broad stable plinth, FRONT SIDE SLIDING door. Upper row shut with a narrow vertical seam. Lower row sliding front door shifted to show shelves, small loop band and a light ball; a separate two panel teal folding exercise FLOOR PAD unfolded flat in front, with one visible flexible seam at mid length. The pad has no legs and is not a raised bench. Heavy dumbbells at bottom shelf, pad stores vertically inside cabinet in upper mode. Cabinet not a wall support or pull anchor. Show no people.
Composition: each object fully inside its own cell, generous white gutters, objects not touching the borders, no arrows. View angles consistent. Mechanisms legible as exploratory sketches, not engineering-certified details. Do not add walls, room decor, plants or extraneous equipment. 3 columns x2 rows, wide landscape image.
